description: This file is a shell script used for testing git apply functionality with various scenarios involving file type changes, renames, symlinks, and binary files. It sets up a repository, creates specific states, generates patches, and applies them to verify correct behavior.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a descriptive label.

methods.name: test_diff_tree
methods.description: Performs a diff-tree operation between commits or states.

methods.name: git update-index
methods.description: Updates the git index (staging area) with specified files.

methods.name: git commit
methods.description: Creates a new commit in the repository.

methods.name: git diff-tree
methods.description: Creates a diff between trees or commits.

methods.name: git apply
methods.description: Applies a patch to the working directory and/or index.

methods.name: test_ln_s_add
methods.description: Adds a symlink to the index, used in setup.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the tests.
